items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: No, a trombone player. Kimery: Grover [Mitchell]?

No, he was a trombone player. This was the guy after him, I think. Oh yeah, Bill Hughes. Anyway, I ordered the record through Amazon – they didn‟t send me one – with the special DVD of making of an LP – a CD. I played the DVD, and through this whole thing, there was not one mention of an arranger or a picture of me. They had a picture – a couple of shots of Lee Musiker, his piano player, making like he‟s conducting a band, but he never conducted the band. They had me – they put me over at the side. They had the…
Let‟s see. It says there were three – they didn‟t even credit it to you. It‟s not . . .
